experiences.position: VP, Point of Sale and Payments Product
experiences.description:
VP, POINT OF SALE AND PAYMENTS PRODUCT (December 2013 to Aug 2015)
Making sure Groupon's POS and Payments products--including Breadcrumb Pro, Breadcrumb Payments and Groupon Point of Sale--are awesome!

VP, SALES & OPERATIONS, MerchantOS (Feb 2013-Nov 2013)
Groupon formed Merchant OS in early 2013 as a self-contained business unit aimed at providing local businesses with world class point of sale, payments and marketing tools. I wore many hats during this time, responsible for Sales, Marketing, Business Operations and Customer Operations.

GM, POS (June 2012 - Jan 2013)
First eight months post-acquisition, Breadcrumb operated as a separate business unit within Groupon. I managed the P&L and had Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Operations and Business Operations reporting to me. Key accomplishments include:

• Integrated Breadcrumb into Groupon technology infrastructure; launched several new sales-blocking features
• Created Sales Team hubs in New York, San Francisco and Chicago. Grew headcount from 2 to 20 and increased monthly close rate by 500%
• Formalized Activation process and spun up dedicated team to onboard new customers; activation productivity per agent quadrupled
• Implemented 24/7 premium support team in Chicago
• Won several prestige accounts (Breadcrumb restaurants currently have 18 Michelin Stars in the US)
• Won PYMNTS.com Award for Best POS

experiences.description:
Breadcrumb is a fully-featured hospitality point of sale built from scratch to run on iPads and delivered in a subscription model that obliterates legacy POS cost.  Breadcrumb is a better way for restaurants, bars, nightclubs and cafes to take orders and payments, manage labor and get insights into their business operations.

Groupon acquired Breadcrumb in May, 2012.  Breadcrumb continues to exist as Groupon's flagship point of sale solution.  In addition, Breadcrumb's backend architecture is the foundation of all other Groupon POS initiatives.
